beginner.zh: NGS 就像把一本書剪成數百萬張小紙條，同時快速讀完，再用電腦拼回原書。它讓定序變得更快、更便宜。
beginner.en: NGS is like cutting a book into millions of slips, reading them all at once, then reassembling the book by computer. It made sequencing faster and cheaper.

advanced.zh: NGS 泛指大規模平行定序。短讀段平台（數十至數百 bp）通量高、成本低；長讀段平台能跨越重複序列與結構變異，但（2016 年時）成本高、通量低。選擇平台取決於研究問題，而非一種技術取代全部。
advanced.en: NGS denotes massively parallel sequencing. Short-read platforms (tens to hundreds of bp) give high throughput at low cost; long-read platforms span repeats and structural variants but were (as of 2016) costlier and lower-throughput. Platform choice follows the research question.

zh: 要找結構變異時，研究者可能選長讀段；大規模族群研究常選短讀段。
en: To find structural variants a study may choose long reads; large population studies often choose short reads.

beginner.zh: WGS 是把整本說明書從頭讀到尾，包括會做蛋白質的章節和其他所有部分。
beginner.en: WGS reads the whole instruction book cover to cover — the protein-coding chapters and everything else.

advanced.zh: WGS 覆蓋編碼與非編碼區，可偵測 SNV、indel 與結構變異；覆蓋深度（coverage）影響偵測靈敏度。WGS、WES 與基因分型晶片常互補使用，例如 1000 Genomes Project 同時使用低覆蓋 WGS、深度 WES 與 array。
advanced.en: WGS covers coding and non-coding regions and detects SNVs, indels and structural variants; coverage depth affects sensitivity. WGS, WES and genotyping arrays are often combined — the 1000 Genomes Project used low-coverage WGS, deep WES and arrays together.

zh: 30× 覆蓋度表示每個鹼基平均被讀到約 30 次。
en: 30× coverage means each base is read about 30 times on average.

beginner.zh: WES 只讀說明書中「真正寫製作方法」的段落（外顯子），大約只占全部的 1.5%，所以比較便宜。
beginner.en: WES reads only the paragraphs that actually describe how to make proteins (exons) — about 1.5% of the whole book — so it costs less.

advanced.zh: WES 先以探針捕捉外顯子再定序，適合尋找影響蛋白質的變異；但會漏掉多數非編碼調控變異，且捕捉效率不均使覆蓋度較不平均。
advanced.en: WES captures exons with probes before sequencing; it suits protein-altering variant discovery but misses most non-coding regulatory variants, and capture efficiency makes coverage less uniform.

zh: 疑似單基因遺傳疾病的診斷可能使用 WES 或 WGS（一般實務，依指引而異；本站未引用來源）。
en: Diagnosis of a suspected monogenic disorder may use WES or WGS (general practice that varies by guideline; not sourced on this site).

beginner.zh: 參考基因體是一本「標準版」說明書。我們把每個人讀到的片段對照它，就能找出哪裡不一樣。
beginner.en: A reference genome is a "standard edition" of the book. We compare each person's reads against it to find differences.

advanced.zh: 參考基因體是比對與變異座標的基準。T2T-CHM13（2022）補上舊參考缺少的約 8%，包括著絲粒與近端著絲粒染色體短臂。參考只是座標系統，不代表「正常」或「理想」的人類序列。
advanced.en: The reference genome is the coordinate system for alignment and variant calls. T2T-CHM13 (2022) filled the ~8% missing from earlier references, including centromeres and acrocentric short arms. A reference is a coordinate system, not a "normal" human sequence.

zh: （示意）變異 chr7:1,234,567 G>A 的座標依賴所用的參考版本。
en: (Illustrative) The coordinate of a variant like chr7:1,234,567 G>A depends on the reference build used.

beginner.zh: 把讀到的片段對回參考基因體後，電腦逐一檢查每個位置，判斷這個人是否帶有不同的版本，這就是 variant calling。
beginner.en: After reads are aligned to the reference, software checks each position to decide whether the person carries a different version — that is variant calling.

advanced.zh: 常見步驟（一般實務，本站未引用來源）：比對（alignment）→ 去除重複 → 鹼基品質校正 → 統計模型判定 genotype → 過濾。GATK 提供這類工具框架並用於 1000 Genomes 與 TCGA。Germline 與 somatic calling 的統計假設不同，後者需處理腫瘤純度與次克隆。
advanced.en: Common steps (general practice, not sourced on this site): alignment → duplicate marking → base-quality recalibration → statistical genotype calling → filtering. GATK provides such a framework and was used in 1000 Genomes and TCGA. Germline and somatic calling differ: somatic calling must handle tumour purity and subclones.

zh: 某位置 30 條讀段中 15 條是 A、15 條是 G：可能是 heterozygous A/G。
en: 15 of 30 reads show A and 15 show G at a site: likely heterozygous A/G.

beginner.zh: VCF 是記錄「哪裡不一樣」的標準表格：哪條染色體、哪個位置、原本是什麼、變成什麼，以及每個人的基因型。
beginner.en: VCF is the standard table of "where it differs": chromosome, position, reference, alternate, and each person's genotype.

advanced.zh: VCF 為文字格式，含 header（##）與固定欄位 CHROM, POS, ID, REF, ALT, QUAL, FILTER, INFO, FORMAT 及樣本欄；可存 SNP、indel 與結構變異，常以 bgzip 壓縮並以 tabix 建索引。
advanced.en: VCF is a text format with header lines (##) and fixed columns CHROM, POS, ID, REF, ALT, QUAL, FILTER, INFO, FORMAT plus sample columns; it stores SNPs, indels and SVs and is usually bgzip-compressed and tabix-indexed.

zh: （示意）chr1  1000  demo1  A  G  …  GT  0|1 → 此人在該位置為 A/G
en: (Illustrative) chr1  1000  demo1  A  G  …  GT  0|1 → this person is A/G at that site

concepts.zh: 突變（生殖細胞系 / 體細胞）

beginner.zh: 從爸媽遺傳來、身體每個細胞都有的變異叫 germline；出生後才在部分細胞中出現的（例如癌細胞）叫 somatic，不會傳給孩子。
beginner.en: A variant inherited from parents and present in every cell is germline; one that arises later in some cells (e.g. cancer cells) is somatic and is not passed to children.

advanced.zh: Germline 變異存在於幾乎所有細胞，是 GWAS 與 PRS 的基礎；somatic 變異只存在部分細胞，是癌症基因體分析重點，常以腫瘤–正常配對樣本偵測。注意：Mutation 是 DNA 序列改變，基因表現（expression）是 RNA 量的改變，兩者不同。
advanced.en: Germline variants are in virtually every cell and underlie GWAS and PRS; somatic variants are present in some cells only, central to cancer genomics, often detected with tumour–normal pairs. Note: a mutation is a DNA sequence change, whereas gene expression is RNA abundance.

zh: 腫瘤中出現、但同一人血液 DNA 中沒有的變異：somatic。
en: A variant found in a tumour but not in the same person's blood DNA: somatic.

beginner.zh: 找到變異後，要判斷它是「會致病」、「不會致病」，還是「還不知道」。臨床上用五個等級來表示。
beginner.en: After a variant is found, labs judge whether it causes disease, is harmless, or is still unknown, using five standard levels.

advanced.zh: ACMG/AMP（2015）五級：Pathogenic、Likely pathogenic、Uncertain significance（VUS）、Likely benign、Benign，依族群頻率、計算預測、功能與共分離等證據組合判定；適用於孟德爾疾病基因，不適用於 GWAS 的常見風險變異。
advanced.en: ACMG/AMP (2015) five tiers — Pathogenic, Likely pathogenic, Uncertain significance (VUS), Likely benign, Benign — combining population, computational, functional and segregation evidence; designed for Mendelian disease genes, not common GWAS risk variants.

zh: 證據不足的變異標為 VUS，不應作為臨床決策依據。
en: A variant with insufficient evidence is a VUS and should not drive clinical decisions.
